organization_note: Beijing Moonshot Technology Co., Ltd. (北京月之暗面科技有限公司), based in Haidian, Beijing, develops the models and operates the Kimi API platform. It trades as Moonshot AI and brands its models and assistant Kimi; the catalog uses the one name Moonshot AI for the models and the platform.
